title: Trial
brief: Rebuild to the standard. What it is: Runs a fair experiment on another widget: alternate sessions with it on and off, and compare how many turns end clean. Known faults of the earlier version: it acts or writes while switched off; it has one long test that never checks the off state, restore from the store, the placements or a narrow card. Keep the idea, design it afresh, and drop what does not earn its place.

stamps.reason: 1. The spec breaks the standard's Lifecycle storage rule (STANDARD.md line 47: $.store is across sessions and read once per session; data shared live between sessions belongs in a file under $.plugin.root). The trial's runs are shared live between sessions but are kept only in the store key 'trial' ('No files'). In the real engine a session's store is cached at its start, so the 'read the store's trial again' step in State and storage returns this session's own stale copy: it never sees a run another open session wrote, nor another session's clear. The following $.store.set of the whole 'trial' value then wipes the other session's run and brings a cleared trial back. A7 (another session's later run survives this session's next write and shows in the totals; a trial ended elsewhere stops the writing and empties the card) and the Off section's rejoin cannot hold outside the kit's map-backed store. Right looks like: the trial (subject and runs) lives in one file under $.plugin.root, read and written with $.fs at join, after each counted turn, at test and at clear, named in Data and in State and storage, with the store holding only isOn; A2, A7, A10 and A11 and the Demo stand-in and Live expectation reworded to the file. Everything else passed review; do not redesign the rest.
stamps.subject: spec

stamps.reason: The earlier rejection is fixed (the trial now lives in a file under the plugin root and the store holds isOn only), no blocking fault in what changed, 12 notes in spec-notes.md.

Built trial-widget to the spec: one command with test and clear, the trial kept in trial.json under the plugin root, a 50 ms join that switches the subject, and 14 acceptance tests; the checker prints PASS with the default Claude Code config but, run as written, stops at 'hooks modules are turned off' because ~/.claude-factory has the rollout switch saved off (every floor widget fails the same way).

Built faithfully to the spec: every state matches its drawing at 20, 40 and 60 columns, off is inert, the live run is the spec's good run with only isOn stored; five minor findings and three items no run can prove (real subject switch, 50 ms join timing, slash commands counted as turns) are in inspection.md.
On the demo page, in the README and the marketplace; smoke test clean
